# One Genomic-Selection Cycle

## Objective

Evaluate genomic prediction honestly, then select a diverse parent set and write a reproducible crossing plan.

```r
library(simitall)

cv <- cross_validate_genomic_prediction(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  phenotype = "results/gwas/cohort.pheno.tsv",
  model = "gblup",
  folds = 5,
  split = "group",
  group = "family",
  true_value = "true_breeding_value",
  seed = 202
)

selection <- run_genomic_selection(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  phenotype = "results/gwas/cohort.pheno.tsv",
  out_prefix = "results/selection/cycle1",
  model = "gblup",
  n_parents = 12,
  n_crosses = 30,
  mating = "minimum_kinship",
  diversity_penalty = 0.25,
  family_data = "results/gwas/cohort.pheno.tsv",
  family_col = "family",
  max_per_family = 3,
  seed = 202
)
```

## Interpretation

Use group-aware CV to estimate deployment performance. Report prediction accuracy, calibration, selected-parent mean GEBV, mean kinship, family representation, and selection differential. This workflow writes one cycle; offspring generation and repeated-cycle genetic gain are a separate step.
